messages:
build-bot: Automated image-scan alert: critical CVE found in transitive dep 'fastjson' (CVE-2026-9999) inside image redwood/backend:staging-20260320. Image auto-quarantined to registry.redwood.internal/quarantine/backend:staging-20260320 :warning:
alice.chu: which layer shows the vulnerable version? can we see the SBOM diff?
benji: SBOM shows fastjson==1.2.3 pulled by analytics-lib@0.8.7 (transitive). vulnerability introduced via poetry lock update earlier today.
carla-sec: thanks. containment steps: 1) keep image quarantined 2) revoke any short-lived deploy tokens used by CI that touched that build 3) check audit logs for external pulls in last 24h.
sam_ops: pulling audit now. quick note: our registry policy currently prevents write pushes from service accounts without `image:write` role; will we need to allow a service account to push fixed images to quarantine namespace for testing?
dave_prod: if we open write perms temporarily we need RBAC change approval. prefer to do rebuild->cosign sign->promote flow without broadening write perms. can sam run a one-off signed rebuild?
carla-sec: agree. do not change global RBAC. grant minimal `image:write` to ci-rebuild-sa scoped to `quarantine/*` for 2 hours if necessary. audit and log everything.
sec-bot: SBOM check job started for rebuilt image (job id: sbom-check-8842). link: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/8842
alice.chu: if rebuild produces a different digest we still need to ensure deterministic deps. can we pin analytics-lib to 0.8.8 which uses fastjson 1.2.4 patched?
benji: 0.8.8 has the patched transitive dep. I've prepared a branch with lockfile bump and test vector run. repeating tests locally passed.
sam_ops: rebuild command for reference: ```bazel build //services/backend:image && cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/signing/cryptoKeys/cosign-key registry.redwood.internal/quarantine/backend:staging-20260320-rebuild```
carla-sec: cosign with KMS key is required. ensure key usage is scoped (KeyRing policy denies export). also add an entry in audit logs that links signing key usage to the rebuild job id.
dave_prod: noted. I will queue the temporary RBAC role binding: `rbac:grant ci-rebuild-sa image:write --scope=quarantine/backend --duration=2h` and record approval in the RBAC audit channel.
sam_ops: rebuild kicked off. will post results.
sec-bot: Rebuild finished: digest changed. SBOM re-scan found no vulnerable fastjson in new image. job link: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/8842#results
carla-sec: good. next: 1) rotate any deploy tokens used by the initial broken build 2) update SBOMs in artifact store 3) add CI gate to prevent lockfile updates that introduce critical CVEs without triage label.
alice.chu: I'll open a PR to add a lockfile policy and a pre-merge check that runs `snyk test` + SBOM diff.
benji: also adding an automated notification to owners when transitive deps change major/patch versions that touch known CVE ranges.
carla-sec: post-incident actions: add playbook entry for "transitive dependency CVE detected in image" — include steps: quarantine, token rotation, KMS-signed rebuild, RBAC minimal grant, audit verification, customer comms template.
dave_prod: I'll draft the RBAC exception template and tag infra-approvers.
sam_ops: last ask: can we add a panic button to the registry UI to snapshot/quarantine tags and freeze manifests? would make containment faster.
carla-sec: +1. create jira for registry freeze feature and mark P2. I will also schedule a short runbook review with oncall.
alice.chu: thanks team. tracking: JIRA-SEC-392 (postmortem + playbook), JIRA-OPS-1210 (registry freeze), PR: github.com/redwood/analytics-lib#42 (lockfile bump).
sec-bot: Incident thread closed for now — monitor for any customer-facing pulls.
carla-sec: reminder: add an audit-log check to the weekly security report so we can verify no external pulls happened while image was quarantined.
